password.title: AdGuardHome Password
password.desc: Generate the bcrypt hash for the users[].password field of AdGuardHome.yaml.
password.hint: The hash is computed locally in this page. Writing it into AdGuardHome.yaml backs up the old file as .bak, and the core must be restarted to take effect. A higher cost is safer but slower.
